source_findings.finding: queue_timer is polled during the inter-attempt wait; the active tick select polls shutdown and tick only.
The global RunLock is held for the entire selected attempt, including explicit PR execution.
Merge reconciliation has an independent future; this does not dispatch queued command work.

limits: Observed queue starvation is not proof sufficient spare full-run capacity existed.
Live worker descendants include running QEMU processes; no hang or safe teardown inferred.
No queue reset, owner pause, cancellation, private environment copying, second worker or gate bypass performed.
No fairness implementation or behavioral test pass claimed.
A fix must preserve the original candidate, positive teardown before lease release, full resource admission, exact-head review and confirmed-merge accounting.
